steps.caption: A neon sunset over the ocean, palms, the title in neon
The scan form on a glass card; the field and Scan in neon
The warnings, the skills and the SKILL.md: glass cards over the sunset

An organisation scanning: the button is Stop, cyan on dark, not Scan's pink
Its tab and its repositories on a card, each count in a pill
A repository in its tab: the same cards
